messages:
sanjay: Heads up — NVD just published CVE-2026-2048 for libssl (OpenSSL). CVSS 7.8, EPSS ~0.02 but our threat intel flags a repo with a partial PoC. May impact our base images `rbx-inference/base:gpu-1.1` and any service built from it. Can someone own quick intake + inventory? /cc @nora @devops-jen

security-bot: NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-2048 | Vendor advisory: https://openssl.org/advisories/2026-04.html | PoC link (sensitive): internal-intel/feeds/2048 (sec-only) :rotating_light:

nora: Taking owner. I'll run a repo scan and image inventory now. Starting with runtime + serving + deploy CI images. Will post list in 30m.

sanjay: Priority hint: Dedicated inference pools and anything in Private VPCs first (customer data). If PoC works remotely, control plane exposures next.

devops-jen: If we can rebuild base images quickly we can push patched images and a lockdown tag. Quick options: 1) rebuild with patched openssl, 2) apply distro patch (apt/yum) in entrypoint, 3) runtime mitigations (seccomp). Which is fastest?

ryan: Rebuild + redeploy is safest. Also consider temporarily reducing RBAC for deploy agents that can decrypt KMS keys for certs — limit blast radius. I can propose a short RBAC tweak: set `deploy-agent` to deny `kms:Decrypt` except for canary namespace.

nora: Inventory update (partial):
- rbx-runtime (images: gpu-1.1, cpu-1.1) -> openssl 1.1.1d (vulnerable)
- serving-router -> built FROM gpu-1.1 base (vulnerable)
- control-plane: some services pinned to ubuntu:18.04 w/ openssl 1.1.1k (patched)
- customer-sidecar images: mixed 
I'll dump full list to the security board.

sanjay: Quick exploitability checks: is this remote RCE or requires local auth? Vendor says 'TLS handshake overflow leading to crash/partial RCE in specific ciphers'. PoC indicates remote but targeted. If remote RCE plausible -> escalate to P0 for affected customer-facing infra.

ryan: I'll enable enhanced audit logging for certificate operations and KMS decrypts in Private VPCs (48h retention extra) so we can detect signs before/after patch. Heads-up: extra logs will cost, but justified for EOD window.

devops-jen: Rebuild plan:
```
# quick loop
docker pull rbx-inference/base:gpu-1.1
FROM rbx-inference/base:gpu-1.1
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y openssl=1.1.1k-1~patch
# bump tag
```
I can start canary image build for `gpu-1.1-patched` now. Need QA window and canary rollout policy.

nora: Suggested severity score flow: if PoC confirmed OR customer terraform shows exposed LB -> S0 (urgent CVE escalated). If PoC absent and EPSS low -> S2 (schedule patch in next weekly build). Current vendor CVSS 7.8 + PoC signal -> treat as high.

sanjay: KMS note: if we rotate cert keys, we need to coordinate with clients on Private. Consider short-lived certs instead of full KMS rotation immediately. Also add audit hook for `kms:Decrypt` events to the alerting rule.

ryan: RBAC snippet I'm proposing (kubectl patch):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: deploy-agent-limit
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-agent
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: deploy-agent-no-kms
```
We'll create `deploy-agent-no-kms` role removing `kms:Decrypt` until canary validates.

devops-jen: Canary rollout timeline: build -> push -> canary in dedicated-pool-1 (10% traffic) -> 30m monitor -> promote. Need approval from sec and SRE.

nora: Action items (assigned):
- nora: full affected-service inventory + PR checklist (by EOD)
- devops-jen: start base-image rebuild + canary tag (in progress)
- ryan: enable KMS/audit logging + propose RBAC patch (in next 20m)
- sanjay: escalate customer-facing infra if PoC validated and notify CS for affected accounts
- security-bot: watch PoC repo and post updates to this thread

sanjay: Good. If anyone finds a simple runtime mitigation (cipher disable, seccomp filter) that buys time, post it here. Otherwise we proceed rebuild -> canary -> promote. :thumbsup:

nora: I'll post the full CSV of services/versions and a recommended priority column when the scan finishes. Expecting ~25 services flagged.

security-bot: Monitoring rule created: alert if >3 failed cert decrypts in 10m in any Private VPC (rule id: sec-2048-audit).
